title: Smart Plug
description: A switchable plug that powers one connected device. Turning the plug on or off also powers or unpowers the device it is connected to — a cross-Thing effect. The device is named by the `device` property, set per instance, so one annotation serves every plug.

on.title: On
on.description: Whether the plug is switched on.

device.title: Connected Device
device.description: Id of the device this plug powers; set per instance.

turnOn.title: Turn On
turnOn.description: Switch the plug on and power the connected device.
turnOn.vre:effects: on' = true; device.powered' = true; output.success = true; output.on = on';

turnOff.title: Turn Off
turnOff.description: Switch the plug off and unpower the connected device.
turnOff.vre:effects: on' = false; device.powered' = false; output.success = true; output.on = on';
